anchor: enabling array-scale
text: We aligned all inserts together, but did not measure positioning error. I changed 'precise alignment' to describe the operation we performed.

anchor: This challenge is particularly relevant to neuronal assays
text: The opening now states the fabrication problem first, then explains why neuronal assays need fine channels between compartments.

anchor: directional tracer movement, primary cortical neuron culture and retrograde axonal labeling
text: Condensed the biological-validation summary into one sentence.

anchor: additional compartment geometries
text: 'Additional compartment geometries' describes what OpenMFD varies without limiting the fabrication method to neuronal assays.

anchor: Compartmentalized neuronal cultures enable independent access
text: Started with the neuronal experiments that motivate the platform and moved the fabrication explanation after the biological context.

anchor: These studies establish that parallelization and adaptable neuronal compartmentalization are feasible.
text: Removed the repeated feasibility summary before the transition to fabrication.

anchor: practical resolution of desktop resin printers
text: Placed the fabrication problem after the neuronal context. The added printer-resolution explanation shows why fine channels need photolithography alongside printed wells. Restored the Table S2 comparison from V7 and removed the duplicated method summary.

anchor: access to a shared cleanroom for reusable mold fabrication
text: Restored V7's shared-cleanroom explanation and Table S2 citation: a lab can obtain a reusable mold from a facility, then cast plates on the bench.

anchor: an example neuronal application
text: Described the neuronal plate as an example application and clarified how the platform carries other compartment layouts into plate-format arrays. Restored V7's practical benefit: later plates need no repeated cleanroom processing.

anchor: Supplementary Protocol S2 describes one-time hybrid mold fabrication
text: Added protocol links to distinguish one-time mold fabrication from routine casting and assays.

anchor: Supplementary Fig. S1
text: Added the Figure S1 citation because those images show the raised edges and the effect of the filter.

anchor: Supplementary Fig. S2
text: Added the Figure S2 citation because the image shows the SU-8 peeling from the wafer.

anchor: Culture survival was assessed qualitatively
text: Removed the warning about unmeasured bond strength because no strength value is claimed.

anchor: because it was faster for these experiments
text: Restored V7's reason for choosing the Opera Phenix: it was faster for these experiments.

anchor: The chamber margin is 17 times the nominal per-side clearance
text: Restored V7's 17-fold comparison between the 1,275 micrometer chamber margin and 75 micrometer pin clearance, which explains how the layout accommodates positioning error without covering the channels.

anchor: established cell-culture
text: Changed 'neuronal culture protocols' to 'cell-culture protocols' because the PDMS/glass culture surfaces are useful beyond neurons. Removed the repeated warning about validating each configuration.

anchor: Nevertheless, the present study did not directly quantify manufacturing time, labor requirements, or cost savings relative to established alternatives, and these potential advantages should be evaluated in future comparisons.
text: Removed the warning about time and cost comparisons because the paragraph describes eliminated operations without claiming numerical savings.

anchor: Our approach extends existing compartmentalized device designs
text: Replaced the statement about what the work does not introduce with its contribution: adapting device layouts into multiwell plate arrays with matching fabrication files.

anchor: These additional designs have not yet been fabricated or biologically tested
text: Shortened the validation warning to the actual status: these layouts have not been fabricated or biologically tested.

anchor: The coordinated design and array-transfer workflow provides an adaptable framework
text: The closing sentence now emphasizes coordinated design, collective insert transfer and reusable molds for spatially controlled cell culture. Removed the demand to establish quantitative fabrication reproducibility, which the paper does not claim.

anchor: The per-device neuronal count table and source images used for quantitative analyses
text: The supplied supplement has pin heights and mold/cast totals. The individual neuronal counts and analysis images need their own data files for submission. I changed the statement so it does not say those files are already supplied.
